# hpe_morpheus_network_router_firewall_rule (Data Source)



## Example Usage - Name

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_router_firewall_rule" "example" {
  name      = "default"
  router_id = 5
}
```

## Example Usage - Id

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_network_router_firewall_rule" "example" {
  id        = 1
  router_id = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `router_id` (Number) The ID of the parent network router.

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the firewall rule.
- `name` (String) The name of the firewall rule.

### Read-Only

- `direction` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `policy` (String)
- `port_range` (String)
- `priority` (Number)
- `protocol` (String)
